name: ha_since
sql: select change_kind, count(*) n, count(distinct match_key) m from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where market='Home/Away' and observed_at >= '2026-09-26T03:55:00Z' group by 1

name: flicker
sql: with r as (select match_key, bookmaker, selection, observed_at, change_kind, lag(change_kind) over (partition by match_key,bookmaker,selection order by observed_at,id) prev, lag(observed_at) over (partition by match_key,bookmaker,selection order by observed_at,id) prev_at, lead(change_kind) over (partition by match_key,bookmaker,selection order by observed_at,id) nxt from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where market='Home/Away' and observed_at >= '2026-09-26T03:55:00Z') select count(*) filter (where change_kind='removed') removed, count(*) filter (where change_kind='removed' and nxt='first_seen') removed_then_back, count(*) filter (where change_kind='removed' and nxt is null) removed_final, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from observed_at-prev_at)) filter (where change_kind='first_seen' and prev='removed') gap_p50_s, max(observed_at-prev_at) filter (where change_kind='first_seen' and prev='removed') gap_max from r

name: removed_live
sql: with r as (select match_key, bookmaker, selection, observed_at, change_kind, event_live, lead(change_kind) over (partition by match_key,bookmaker,selection order by observed_at,id) nxt from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where market='Home/Away' and observed_at >= '2026-09-26T03:55:00Z') select coalesce(r.event_live::text,'null') live, count(*) from r where change_kind='removed' and nxt='first_seen' group by 1

name: prelive_flicker
sql: with r as (select match_key, bookmaker, selection, observed_at, change_kind, lead(change_kind) over (partition by match_key,bookmaker,selection order by observed_at,id) nxt, lead(event_live) over (partition by match_key,bookmaker,selection order by observed_at,id) nxt_live from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where market='Home/Away' and observed_at >= '2026-09-26T03:55:00Z') select count(*) n, count(distinct match_key) matches, count(distinct match_key||bookmaker) pairs from r where change_kind='removed' and nxt='first_seen' and nxt_live is false

name: prelive_flicker_sample
sql: with r as (select match_key, bookmaker, selection, observed_at, change_kind, price, prev_price, lead(change_kind) over (partition by match_key,bookmaker,selection order by observed_at,id) nxt, lead(observed_at) over (partition by match_key,bookmaker,selection order by observed_at,id) nxt_at, lead(price) over (partition by match_key,bookmaker,selection order by observed_at,id) nxt_price, lead(event_live) over (partition by match_key,bookmaker,selection order by observed_at,id) nxt_live from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where market='Home/Away' and observed_at >= '2026-09-26T03:55:00Z') select match_key, bookmaker, selection, observed_at removed_at, prev_price, nxt_at back_at, nxt_price from r where change_kind='removed' and nxt='first_seen' and nxt_live is false order by observed_at limit 15

name: live_rows
sql: select coalesce(event_live::text,'null') live, change_kind, count(*) from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where market='Home/Away' and observed_at >= '2026-09-26T03:55:00Z' group by 1,2 order by 1,2
